Home.headline: A clean base for the Naano build.
Home.intro: The project is ready for the next phase: a Next.js app with Tailwind CSS, lucide icons, internationalized copy, Drizzle migrations, and a MySQL health check.

i18n.title: Internationalized from day one
i18n.body: Visible copy is routed through next-intl so additional locales can be added without rewriting the interface.

database.title: MySQL-ready data layer
database.body: Drizzle ORM is configured for MySQL with schema files and migration scripts.

health.title: Operational health endpoint
health.body: The API reports whether the service is running and whether the database can answer a query.

ui.title: Prototype-friendly UI
ui.body: Tailwind CSS and lucide-react are installed so the first real product screens can move quickly.
